mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, it is 57 degrees with clear skies at Firemans Park under a Waning Crescent moon. Looking ahead, we will see an overnight low of 48 degrees with no rain predicted.

The Verona Common Council recently voted unanimously to adopt the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This long-range strategy focuses on enhancing local neighborhoods, supporting our regional employment hubs, and maintaining a welcoming downtown area.

There is plenty happening around town. Today you can catch yoga at Insight Wellness or trivia at Hop Haus. Tomorrow, look out for live music at Baileys Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the Puppets in the Park festival this Friday.
In a noteworthy report from September 28, Verona police responded to a crash involving a 16-year-old operating an eMoto recklessly, resulting in multiple citations for the driver.
The delicious flavor of the day is Double Strawberry. The restaurant is currently open but will be closing soon in 42 minutes, so be sure to stop by before they lock up for the night.
